## Description

Pre-panel filter for HVAC pre-filtration stages, with synthetic-fiber media. The source confirms the synthetic media but dimension, media and grade are recorded as reference figures A pre-stage protects the downstream media and trades low resistance for high capacity. Buyers should confirm the grade and face size against the AHU, and request pressure-drop and dust-holding data for energy-cost comparison before ordering.
